name: Perfect Repulsion creates a prevent-exact-X shield
notes: Perfect Repulsion's element is WATER, so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real WATER champion (Spirit of Water, reused from coriolis-ward-prevent-level). The target-resolution handler recomputes X as the card resolves, so two cards in memory produce PREVENT_EXACT_2. Only the shield's creation is covered; the 'draw a card if damage was prevented this way' clause is a separate deferred trigger that requires an actual damage event afterward and is out of scope.

rulesClauses: The next time target unit you control would take exactly X damage this turn, prevent that damage, where X is the amount of cards in your memory.
